title: HIP HOP Dance Choreography Tutorial for Beginners - Free Dance Class at Home

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor guides students through a step-by-step breakdown, starting with legs before adding arms and music. She maintains an encouraging and upbeat tone while repeating counts and gradual tempo progressions.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher welcomes viewers and explains the tutorial structure
Teacher explains she will mirror movements and starts teaching legs
Teacher combines leg and arm movements together
Practice combined choreography with music at a slow tempo
Teacher adds the next part of the choreography

steps_taught.name: Leg Taps and Cross Steps
steps_taught.description: Tapping left and right feet out, then stepping across.

steps_taught.name: Arm Extensions and Fists
steps_taught.description: Stretching arms down, bending forearms, and punching to the side.

what_works: Isolating upper and lower body before combining them
Gradually increasing the tempo of practice
what_hinders: Lack of back-facing view makes learning complex turns or footwork harder to follow

quotes.text: We will develop step by step the choreography.
I will mirror the movements for you.
Don't worry if it doesn't work.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher stands facing the camera in a studio setting, explaining foot placement while demonstrating mirrored steps.
Teacher demonstrates arm extensions downwards and bending forearms in parallel lines.

extraction.distinctive_method: Breaking down the upper and lower body movements completely independently before attempting any synchronization.
